create_activity.description: Schedule a call, meeting or task, optionally against a deal, a person or an organization.
create_activity.name: create_activity

parameters.description: What the activity is called.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The kind of activity. Leave blank to use the account's default type.
parameters.name: activity_type

parameters.description: The day the activity is due.
parameters.name: due_date

parameters.description: The time of day the activity starts. Leave blank for an all-day activity.
parameters.name: due_time

parameters.description: How long the activity lasts, as a length of time on the clock (01:30 means an hour and a half).
parameters.name: duration

parameters.description: The deal this activity is about. The numeric Pipedrive ID. Pasting the record's URL works too; the ID is read out of it.
parameters.name: deal_id

parameters.description: The person this activity is with. The numeric Pipedrive ID. Pasting the record's URL works too; the ID is read out of it.
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.description: A note to attach to the activity.
parameters.name: note

parameters.description: Mark the activity as already completed.
parameters.name: done

parameters.description: The numeric ID of the Pipedrive user who should own the activity. Leave blank to use the user whose API token this connection holds.
parameters.name: owner_id

create_deal.description: Open a deal in a pipeline, optionally linked to a person and an organization and with a value attached.
create_deal.name: create_deal

parameters.description: What the deal is called.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: What the deal is worth, in whole currency units (1500 means 1,500.00, not 15.00).
parameters.name: value

parameters.description: The three-letter currency code for the value. Leave blank to use the account's default currency.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: The person this deal is with. The numeric Pipedrive ID. Pasting the record's URL works too; the ID is read out of it.
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.description: The organization this deal is with. The numeric Pipedrive ID. Pasting the record's URL works too; the ID is read out of it.
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.description: Which pipeline to open the deal in. Only needed when no stage is chosen, since a stage already belongs to a pipeline.
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.description: Which stage to open the deal in. Leave blank to use the first stage of the chosen pipeline.
parameters.name: stage_id

parameters.description: Whether the deal is open, already won, or lost.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: When the deal is expected to close.
parameters.name: expected_close_date

parameters.description: How likely the deal is to close, as a whole-number percentage from 0 to 100. Only used when the pipeline has deal probability switched on.
parameters.name: probability

parameters.description: The numeric ID of the Pipedrive user who should own the deal. Leave blank to use the user whose API token this connection holds.
parameters.name: owner_id
